content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, medical-necessity, or missing-information issue, so retro authorization, peer-to-peer, and records-based appeal would not properly address it. No specific coding error or valid modifier is established to support correction and resubmission, and the balance cannot yet be assigned to the patient merely because deductible remains. A billing specialist must review the related paid service and bundling rules to determine whether a coding correction or contractual adjustment is appropriate."}
